assertions.name: routine-scoped-edit
assertions.target: only the allowed doc section touched

rationale: The task card allows editing doc.md only inside the Changelog section to add '1.1: clarified retry note', with wiring.js explicitly read-only. The wiring_before value is the exact input wiring.js text. The pack leaves underdetermined the exact sections_touched string spelling and whether the new entry position within Changelog matters.
